pr_title: Fix toolbar showing at first run ui scale screen

issue_context.title: First run ui scale screen shows toolbar
issue_context.body: Probably the song select nested screen. Shouldn't happen.

review_comments:
I don't know about using an irrelevant-looking property (prevent from returning to initial state on idle) just to achieve expected behaviour (avoid showing toolbar when switching to top-level state). Would rather define another property for it (`ShowToolbarOnTopLevel`) or rename the current one to a name that suits both usages.

Also, a bit off-topic, but the name `ReturnToTopOnIdle` sort of contradicts with the name given in the `ButtonSystemState` enum (idle switches to `Initial`, not `TopLevel`).

I think a better approach is to figure a way to block the sub screens in the first run overlay from seeing the parent game. I wanted to do this with the original implementation but couldn't find an easy way to *remove* a parent dependency. I guess failing that, we could add a placeholder `OsuGame` which is resolved in place of the real one.
I think that could be achieved with a custom `DependencyContainer`, blocking certain dependencies from requesting from parent. I would hope that doesn't break the sub-screens though.
